ミープルは7個しかありません。強いAIの差がいちばん大きく出たのは、この使い方で: You only have 7 meeples. This is where the strong AI differed most.
序盤に一気に使い切らない: Don't use them all up early
置ける場所があるとつい置きたくなりますが、強いAIは置けるのに置かない手が目先の: It's tempting to place a meeple whenever you can, but the strong AI declines to place one more often than the greedy AI and uses them more slowly. At the end of the opening (48 tiles left) it still has {{supply48_strong}} in hand on average. One spare meeple lets you seize big chances, such as joining an opponent's city or claiming a large field. From the middle game on, the strong AI also uses almost all of them ({{supply24_strong}} on average with 24 tiles left), so think "don't rush to place them all" rather than "hoard them".
<span class=\"what\">手持ちがあるのに、あえてミープルを置か: Share of turns where it chose not to place a meeple despite having one
手持ちミープル数の平均（手番を迎えたとき）。山札の残りが48枚の時点で、強いAI: Average meeples in hand at the start of a turn. With 48 tiles left, the strong AI has {{supply48_strong}} and the greedy AI {{supply48_greedy}}.
道に乗せるのは「すぐ終わる道」だけ: Only claim roads that will end soon
道は1タイル1点と安く、端が決まらないといつまでも完成しません。強いAIが道にミ: Roads are cheap at 1 point per tile, and they never finish if the ends aren't fixed. The strong AI mostly puts meeples on roads when extending an existing road, and those meeples come back quickly. Only {{road_new}}% of its road meeples started a new road.
<span class=\"what\">道に置いたミープルが戻ってくるまでの平: Average time until a road meeple returns ({{road_join}}% of the strong AI's road meeples were placed on existing roads)
ミープルを置いてから戻るまでの平均手番数（自分の手番で数える）。農民は終局まで戻: Average number of turns from placing a meeple until it returns (counting your own turns). Farmers stay until the end.
都市は、自分で新しく始めて育てる: Start your own new cities and grow them
強いAIは置いたミープルの{{city_share_strong}}%が都市でし: {{city_share_strong}}% of the strong AI's meeples went into cities (greedy AI: {{city_share_greedy}}%). And {{city_new_strong}}% of those were placed on the first tile of a new, unclaimed city. A completed city is worth a lot, 2 points per tile plus 2 per shield, and a city of your own is hard for others to interfere with.
<span class=\"what\">都市に置いたミープルのうち、新しい都市: Share of city meeples placed in a new city (one not connected to anything)
農民は数を絞り、完成した都市の多い草原へ: Few farmers, in fields with many completed cities
農民（草原のミープル）は終局まで戻ってきませんが、1個あたり平均{{farm_p: Farmers (meeples in fields) stay until the end, but at {{farm_points}} points each on average they earn more than any other placement. Even so, the strong AI places only {{farm_per_player}} farmers per game on average, fewer than the greedy AI ({{farm_per_player_greedy}}). It spreads them out, {{farm_early_strong}}, {{farm_mid_strong}} and {{farm_late_strong}} on average in the opening, middle and end game, and late on it puts returning meeples into fields that touch many completed cities.
農民は数より場所です。勝った側と負けた側の草原の点の差は平均{{lead_F_s: With farmers, location matters more than count. The average gap in field points between winners and losers is {{lead_F_signed}}, and it grows or shrinks with the AI version and the luck of the games (where the gap comes from). Don't place so many early that you run short for cities, but when you find a field where completed cities are likely to gather, claim it.
<span class=\"what\">強いAIの農民（1人1局あたり平均{{: The strong AI's farmers ({{farm_per_player}} per player per game on average, on the board for {{farm_turns}} turns on average)
強いAIは、自分の特徴を伸ばすだけでなく、相手の特徴にも手を出します。相手の特徴: The strong AI doesn't just extend its own features; it also gets involved with its opponent's. It placed a tile touching an opponent's feature on {{touch_opp_strong}}% of turns, versus {{touch_opp_greedy}}% for the greedy AI.
相手の大きな都市には、合流して分け合う: Join your opponent's big city and share it
相手の都市にミープルがいると直接は置けませんが、隣に自分の小さな都市を作ってミー: You can't place directly in a city your opponent occupies, but you can start your own small city next to it with a meeple and connect them later with a tile. With equal meeples, both players score in full. In the strong AI's games, {{shared_share}}% of all points came from such shared features.
相手の都市を「完成しない形」にする<span class=\"adv\">上級<: Make your opponent's city uncompletableAdvanced
都市の隣に、残りのタイルでは埋められない穴を作ると、その都市はもう完成しません。: If you leave a hole next to a city that none of the remaining tiles can fill, the city can never be completed. Instead of 2 points per tile when completed, it scores only 1 per tile at the end. The strong AI played this move {{block_ratio}} times as often as the greedy AI.
強いAIは1人1局あたり平均{{block_strong}}回（{{games_: The strong AI plays this {{block_strong}} times per player per game on average ({{block_count_strong}} times in {{games_strong}} games). But you can only aim for it if you count the remaining tiles. As a beginner, focus on completing your own cities first; "when unsure where to place, consider spots that get in the way of your opponent's city" is enough.
<span class=\"what\">1人1局あたり、相手の都市を完成不能に: Times per player per game it made an opponent's city uncompletable
修道院は、周りを自分で埋めて9点を取りに行く: Fill around your monastery yourself and go for 9
修道院のミープルは平均{{mon_points}}点を取りますが、{{mon_s: A monastery meeple scores {{mon_points}} points on average, but {{mon_stuck}}% are never completed. When there are gaps around its monastery, the strong AI fills them with its own tiles.
勝った側は都市で積み上げる: Winners pile up points in cities
勝った側と負けた側の点を得点源ごとに比べると、勝った側は都市でも多く取っていまし: Comparing winners and losers by source of points, winners also scored more in cities. From the winner's side, the gaps are cities {{lead_C_signed}}, fields {{lead_F_signed}}, monasteries {{lead_M_signed}} and roads {{lead_R_signed}}. Apart from cities, the gaps change order or even flip with the AI version and the luck of the games, so wins come from many small gains rather than one decisive factor. Field points also come from completed cities, so cities are the foundation. When in doubt, prefer moves that complete your own cities and that claim fields touching completed cities.

ミープルは序盤に一気に使い切らない。序盤の終わりに1〜2個残っているくらいがよい: Don't use up your meeples early. Having 1–2 left at the end of the opening is about right.
道に乗せるのは、すぐ終わりそうな道だけ。: Only claim roads that look like they'll end soon.
都市は自分で新しく始めて育てる。勝った側は都市でも多く取る（草原の点も完成した都: Start your own new cities and grow them. Winners score more in cities (field points also come from completed cities).
農民は数を絞る。終盤に余ったミープルは、完成した都市にたくさん接する草原へ。: Keep farmers few. Late in the game, put spare meeples in fields that touch many completed cities.
相手の大きな都市には合流して分け合う。慣れてきたら、完成しない形にする手も考える: Join your opponent's big cities and share them. Once you're comfortable, also look for moves that make them uncompletable.
修道院の周りは自分で埋めて、ミープルを早く取り戻す。: Fill in around your monastery yourself to get the meeple back quickly.
